PluginData.Author: Bunio
PluginData.Tooltip: Type /data in chat to set it up. Your grid's data in windows on the HUD, plus inventory logistics.
PluginData.Description:
START HERE: sit in a cockpit and type /data in chat. Nothing shows on the HUD until you add windows in that menu, and Logistics is switched on there too.
Live data of the grid you sit in, drawn on the HUD: power, cargo, ores, ingots, refineries, autocrafting, block details. Automatic LCDs 2 style elements, no LCD panels needed. Per-grid profiles and named window templates.
Calculators: - Production: what autocrafting is missing, broken down into ingots, missing ingots, ore to refine and refinery time. - Refineries: ingots and time from any amount of ore, with speed and yield modules.
Logistics (runs while you sit in the grid): - Sorting into Ores / Ingots / Components / Tools / Ammo / Bottles containers, special containers. - Refineries: your ore order, every ore split equally. - Ice, uranium, bottles and ammo for weapons, also on docked ships. - Autocrafting by limits, split across all assemblers. - Optional small PB script keeps refineries and reactors balanced 24/7.
Polish and English.
Guide and bugs: https://github.com/bunio80/DaneHud
